name: Gin Toolbar Local Tasks
description: Moves the current page's local task tabs into the administration toolbar.

suggests.drupal/gin_toolbar: Only needed when wanting to use the local tasks in combination with the gin toolbar in the frontend.

project_description:
Move the local tasks to the toolbar.

 While the module name is Gin Toolbar Local Tasks, the Gin Toolbar is not needed (anymore). This name was chosen when thought the Gin Toolbar was needed, but it only needs the Admin Toolbar.

 1.x 

 The release that still contains the dependency on Gin Toolbar.

 2.x 

 The release that does not have a dependency on Gin Toolbar anymore. See the release notes on how to upgrade.
